params.creatorOffer: Extra USDC reward for CRE forwarder, paid at Phase 1 reveal
params.optionCount: Number of binary submarkets (0 or 1 = single implicit submarket)
params.question: The market question
params.ticketCost: Cost per ticket in USDC (6 decimals)
params.tradingDuration: Duration of trading phase in seconds

returns.marketId: The ID of the created market

createSubmarket(uint256,uint256,string).details: Callable by the market creator or owner.      Submarket ID is deterministic: keccak256(abi.encode(parentMarketId, optionIndex)).

params.optionIndex: Zero-based option index (must be < optionCount, or 0 for single-option)

onReport(bytes,bytes).details: Selector 0 = phase1 (reveal), selector 1 = phase2 (resolve).      Both use bytes32 submarketId in the encoded report.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPenaltyFactors(bytes32,address[],uint.details: Only callable by CRE forwarder. Factor in bps: 0=no penalty, 10000=100% penalty.

submitEncrypted(uint256,bytes,bytes32).details: Parent market must not have been revealed yet.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimPayout(bytes32).notice: Claim payout for winning shares, applying any penalty set by CRE.

claimShares(bytes32,(bytes32,bytes32[],u.notice: Claim initial shares via merkle proof (per submarket).

createMarket(string,string,uint256,uint2.notice: Create a new prediction market with optional multiple binary submarkets.

createSubmarket(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Register a submarket for a parent market.

executeOrderbookTrade(bytes32,address,ad.notice: Execute a P2P trade from the orderbook (YES <-> NO shares only).

onReport(bytes,bytes).notice: Handles incoming keystone reports from the Forwarder.

requestInfoReveal(uint256).notice: Request info phase reveal after drand round is reached.

requestResolution(bytes32).notice: Request resolution after trading period ends.

resolveMarket(bytes32,uint8).notice: Resolve a submarket with winning outcome.

revealInfoPhase(bytes32,bytes32,uint8,ui.notice: Reveal info phase for a specific submarket.

setPenaltyFactors(bytes32,address[],uint.notice: Set per-agent penalty factors before resolution.

swapShares(bytes32,uint8,uint256).notice: AMM-style swap: burn shares of one outcome, receive shares of the other.
